title: GTA6 Alternative? NTE Open World Gets Tycoon Update
description: As GTA6 approaches, Hotta Studio's anime-inspired open world NTE is getting a big update on November 11th featuring city logistics and tycoon gameplay.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Keeping Busy While Waiting for GTA6

While the real *GTA6* may be right around the corner, players looking for something to keep them occupied in the meantime have alternative open-world options receiving updates. According to a report by gaming outlet Push Square, Hotta Studio’s anime-inspired open world game *NTE* is scheduled to receive a major update on November 11th.

## New Tycoon Mode and City Logistics

One of the standout additions in this upcoming update is a mode that allows players to manage city logistics, bringing a full tycoon-style management experience into the open-world framework. For players who enjoy combining open-world freedom with strategic resource and logistical management, this new mode aims to offer fresh engagement.

In addition to the logistics management mode, the update will follow customary traditions by delivering a wealth of additional content. Players can look forward to two brand new characters, new story quests, and more as part of the November 11th rollout.

## Editor's Take

With *GTA6* dominating industry conversations, open-world titles like *NTE* are wise to keep their communities engaged through substantial updates. Adding tycoon-style city logistics gives players a unique diversion while they count down the days to Rockstar's next masterpiece.
